raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely and incorrectly disambiguated “Rostov” as Rostov-on-Don, assuming modern default usage, instead of considering the historical and hagiographic context. John the Hairy (a 16th-century Orthodox saint “of Rostov”) is associated with Rostov the Great (Rostov Veliky) in Yaroslavl Oblast, not Rostov-on-Don (founded later). This assumption was made without verifying authoritative sources and led the process toward the wrong territorial entity.
